Made for your everyday screen

Protection that fits the way you use your Mac.

Sitr lives quietly in your menu bar and gives you control over what appears across the apps you choose.

01 / CHOOSE

Your choice of people

Hide women, men, or everyone. Strict Mode can also cover people Sitr cannot classify.

02 / CUSTOMIZE

Three ways to cover

Use a soft blur, pixelation, or a solid block. Adjust the look in Settings at any time.

03 / CONTROL

Protection where you want it

Choose which apps Sitr protects, pause from the menu bar, or hold your shortcut to reveal temporarily.

Simple to start

Set it once. Stay in your flow.

Sitr works in the background after a short setup. You can revisit every choice whenever you need.

01

Install the Mac app

Open the DMG from the latest GitHub release and drag Sitr to Applications.

02

Allow Screen Recording

macOS asks for permission so Sitr can find people on your screen. Sitr does not record audio.

03

Choose your protection

Pick who to hide, a cover style, and the apps to protect. Sitr stays in your menu bar.

Built for privacy

Your screen stays yours.

Detection runs on your Mac. Sitr is sandboxed without network access, and screen frames stay in memory instead of being saved to disk.

See how to verify it yourself ↗

Nothing to upload.
Nothing to sign in to.
Just your screen, your rules.

Open source under GPL-3.0. The app requires Screen Recording permission to protect your screen.

Ready when you are

Make space for what matters.

Download the DMG from the latest GitHub release. Requires macOS 15 or later and Apple silicon.
